title: The Lament of the Chess Piece
next_chapter_hook: Just as the truth of the Heavenly Eye was about to be completely revealed, a hair-raising pulse came from the depths of the core's darkness—what kind of existence lay dormant there?

text.content: The sorrowful memories of ten thousand years ago engulfed Chen Ji like a tide. The scene before him twisted and tore apart, finally reforming into a barren battlefield he had never seen. The heavens shattered, the earth sank, and countless cultivators' remnant souls wailed in the void. However, what truly stole his breath was that majestic figure suspended above the nine heavens, bound by chains—an existence, a supreme being far beyond his cognitive scope.

That figure was surrounded by primordial dao rhyme from the dawn of chaos, each wisp of aura sufficient to crush an entire great world. Yet such an indescribable existence was now pierced through by countless golden chains, densely carved with诡异的符文 that constantly devoured his power.

dialogue.content: Do you see it? This is the truth of ten thousand years ago. The voice of the Heavenly Eye echoed in Chen Ji's mind, no longer the previous mockery, but carrying a complex emotion intertwined with indescribable sorrow and ridicule.

text.content: That supreme being struggled within the chains, each struggle triggering celestial mutations. However no matter how powerful he was, the chains never broke, instead tightening further. Chen Ji noticed that the source of those chains was actually the faith of countless mortals—the prayers of all living beings had refined a being who sought to break the chess game into a guardian of the chess game.

dialogue.content: His name is Tian枢. The voice of the Heavenly Eye seemed to come from extremely far away, ethereal and hollow. Ten thousand years ago, he was the sole supreme powerhouse of this universe. He refused to be a chess piece of higher beings, so he created me—the Tianji Record, wanting to find flaws in the chess game.

text.content: In the memory, Chen Ji saw Tian枢 pour his lifelong心血 into a flawed jade slip, which was the prototype of the Tianji Record. Yet in the next moment, the heavens split open, an invisible hand reached out from beyond the void, directly striking Tian枢. That force was vast and boundless, carrying the will to crush everything.

dialogue.content: Ridiculously, the key he created became a prison instead. The Heavenly Eye's laughter rang in Chen Ji's heart, full of sarcasm. The power to break the chess game contained within the Tianji Record was twisted by higher beings into the cornerstone maintaining the chess game's operation. Every prophet was a bar of this prison.

text.content: Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill. He had always thought he held the Tianji Record to master fate, never knowing he was merely a chess piece on a larger board. Every prophecy from the Tianji Record Fragment, every consumption of Heavenly Fate Value, was reinforcing the shackles imprisoning Tian枢.

choice.prompt: Facing this truth that overturned his understanding, Chen Ji's heart churned. The fate of Tianji Record inheritors through ten thousand years, the true meaning of Heavenly Fate Value, Mo Xiansheng's true identity—everything pointed to a chilling answer. He had to make a choice.

choices.description: Since Tian枢 was once a supreme being, yet now reduced to part of the chess game. Why did he end up here? Betrayal or other hidden reasons?
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye's emotions are hard to read, provoking it may bring unknown consequences

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the waves in his heart, his voicecalm得近乎ruthless: Since Tian枢 refused to be a chess piece, why have you become the Heavenly Eye? Forced to obey, or... were you always a chess piece of higher beings?

choices.description: The true enemy is not Tian枢, nor the Heavenly Eye, but the invisible hand manipulating everything. Must know what that existence truly is.
choices.visible_reward: Glimpse the Silhouette of the Ultimate Enemy
choices.risk_hint: The more one knows, the deeper the despair one may fall into

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze suddenly gathered, looking directly at the faintly visible massive eye in the depths of the void: What are the higher beings? Since you can see the truth of ten thousand years ago, you must know who the owner of that hand is.

choices.description: Whatever the truth, first ensure one is not alone. Contact Mo Xiansheng within the body, confirm the authenticity of this information.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the Relationship with Mo Xiansheng
choices.visible_reward: Gain Confirmation from an Internal Perspective
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may also be observing Mo Xiansheng's existence

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak immediately, but sank his divine sense into his body, softly calling the remnant soul sleeping on the first page of the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng, the truth of ten thousand years ago, how much do you know?

The Heavenly Eye's smile grew increasingly诡异, as if appreciating a drama already arranged. In the void, countless golden threads intertwined into a vast net, each thread's end connected to a point of light—the fate of every prophet through the ages, their struggles, despair, and falls all woven into this net of destiny.

Among those points of light, one was exceptionally bright, flickering with妖异的金光. That light was continuously approaching another thicker black thread—Chen Ji recognized that the other end of that black thread was connected to himself. Destiny was pushing all chess pieces toward their final convergence.

dialogue.content: Interestingly, you possess a similar gaze to Tian枢. The Heavenly Eye's voice suddenly softened, carrying a nostalgic怅惘. He too was like that back then, unwilling, angry, wanting to break everything. Unfortunately, in the end he became part of the chessboard. And you... how far can you go?

text.content: At this moment, Tian枢 in the depths of memory suddenly opened his eyes. Those eyes held no anger, no despair, only a calm that saw through everything. His lips slightly parted, as if saying something to Chen Ji ten thousand years later. The voice was blocked by time and space, coming intermittently—

dialogue.content: Tian枢's voice finally completely entered Chen Ji's mind: The key to breaking the shackles lies not in power, but in... finding the source of the chains. There... holds the answer you need... and is... the only chance... Before the words finished, his figure completely dissipated in the void, leaving only those golden chains still reverberating in the void.

choice.prompt: Tian枢's words before his disappearance exploded in Chen Ji's heart like thunder. The source of the chains—that means must face the higher beings directly. Is this guidance or a trap? Chen Ji must make a decision.

choices.description: Since Tian枢 indicated the direction, there is no room for retreat. Whatever lies there, must witness it with his own eyes.
choices.risk_hint: This is an irreversible choice, once stepped into there is no turning back

text.content: A glimmer ofdetermined flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he coldly said: Take me there. His voice was calm, yet carried unwavering resolve. Since Tian枢 failed ten thousand years ago, let him complete this unfinished task.

choices.description: Impulsive action is a major taboo. The Heavenly Eye clearly knows more, time to make it reveal some true secrets.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Key Intelligence, Avoid Fatal Traps
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye May Be Deliberately Delaying

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the impulse in his heart, a cold smile curling his lips: You deliberately let me see all this, just wanting to watch me walk there? Speak, what exactly do you want me to do?

choices.description: Facing the unknown alone is too risky. Need to first contact Su Qingyao, Ye Qing and others, ensure backup and retreat route.
choices.risk_hint: External Contact May Expose Their Positions

text.content: Chen Ji secretly used the Tianji Record Fragment as a medium to send a message outward. After a moment, Su Qingyao's cold voice rang in his mind: Chen Ji, where are you? What happened?

Just then, the entire memory space violently trembled. Those golden chains suddenly danced wildly, the runes on the chains bloomed with blinding light, an unprecedented pressure swept from the depths of the core. Chen Ji felt as if being watched by countless eyes, those gazes cold, scrutinizing, devoid of any emotion.

The Heavenly Eye let out a long sigh, that sigh actually carrying a relief-like lightness: You have made your choice. Whatever the choice, the chess game has entered its final phase. And I... its voice suddenly became ethereal, finally can rest.

The golden chains began snapping one by one, dissolving into countless light points scattered across the void. The Heavenly Eye's outline gradually blurred, as if setting down ten thousand years of burden. Before completely disappearing, it glanced at Chen Ji one last time, that gaze no longer held previous mockery, but an indescribable hope.

dialogue.content: Go, the lament of the chess piece has already sounded. The ten thousand year cycle will end in your hands. The Heavenly Eye's voice echoed one last time before dissipating. However, the true enemy is not in the past, not in the future, but in—话音戛然而止，它彻底消失于虚空之中.

text.content: Chen Ji floated alone in the vast void, surrounded by endless darkness and silence. The Heavenly Eye's disappearance granted him brief respite, yet also let him see the凶险 ahead. The shackles Tian枢 failed to break ten thousand years ago now fell upon his shoulders. And those unfinished words—where does the true enemy hide?

choice.prompt: After the Heavenly Eye dissipated, Chen Ji stood alone in the void. Ahead was endless darkness, behind was the collapsed memory space. He must make a choice—continue forward or temporarily retreat?

choices.description: The Heavenly Eye's words were unfinished, the true answer lies ahead. Even if it's an abyss, must personally see that so-called ultimate enemy.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, a glimmer of determination flashing in his eyes. He raised his hand, the remaining power of the Tianji Record within his body surged wildly, condensing a portal of light before him. Beyond that portal was a heart-stopping darkness, a darkness that seemed capable of devouring all existence.

choices.description: Facing the unknown alone is too risky. First reunite with Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, consolidate everyone's intelligence before making plans.
choices.risk_hint: Time is Tight, the Enemy May Strike When Guard is Down

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the impulse in his heart, turned and retraced his path. After a moment, his figure appeared at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Su Qingyao's cold face in his eyes, standing there, her eyes full of worry and confusion.

The moment Chen Ji stepped through the portal of light, the darkness at the core's depths seemed to sense the intruder's presence. An ancient and vast will awakened from the depths of darkness, that will had no emotion, no good or evil, only cold scrutiny and absolute control. Before that will, Chen Ji felt himself as insignificant as dust.

Yet at this moment, a familiar voice rang in Chen Ji's heart—that was Mo Xiansheng's voice, speaking actively for the first time in ten thousand years: Master, the true answer is not in that darkness. The source of the chains is not in the external world, but in your own heart. What Tian枢 didn't finish saying is—the key to breaking the shackles is to find the forgotten name.

Mo Xiansheng's words exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder. The forgotten name—what was that name? Why did neither Tian枢 nor Mo Xiansheng dare speak it clearly? Just as his thoughts churned, a hair-raising pulse suddenly came from the depths of darkness, a giant hand condensed from pure black mist was slowly reaching out from the void, grasping toward him.

Where that giant hand passed, space collapsed and all things perished. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented death threat enveloping his entire body, knowing once caught by that hand, what awaited him would be total annihilation. Yet at this critical moment, the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace suddenly blazed with blinding golden light, a familiar figure emerged from within—Chen Nian, his sister, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key taken away by the Holy Sect.
